trConnections.label: T.R. was here
trConnections.place: Bighorn Mountains high country, Ten Sleep and Crazy Woman headwaters
trConnections.text: In September 1884 T.R. hunted elk and grizzly bears in the high country of Wyoming's Bighorn Mountains, where he killed his first bear on September 13.

sources.name: T.R. diary, Aug.-Sept. 1884 entries (Library of Congress, Theodore Roosevelt Papers, Series 8, Personal Diaries)
Theodore Roosevelt, The Wilderness Hunter (1893): 'In 1884, on a trip to the Bighorn Mountains, I killed three bear, six elk and six deer'
Hermann Hagedorn, Roosevelt in the Bad Lands (1921), ch. X-XI (from interviews with Merrifield and the diaries)
